semantics.governance_rule: Retention, hold, privacy, certification and contractual obligations remain enforced.
semantics.ownership_rule: Service retirement does not imply data ownership disappears.
semantics.verification_rule: Disposition result is verified and audited.
semantics.destructive_rule: Purge uses destructive gates and exact scope.
semantics.authority_rule: Retirement plan does not bypass data governance.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
